RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: SELECT d.reviewedBy_displayName AS ApproverName, d.reviewedBy_userPrincipalName AS Approver, d.stages_reviewedDateTime AS ApprovalTimestamp, d.stages_justification AS ApproverComment, r.justification AS RequestorJustification FROM requestDetail d LEFT JOIN requestInfo r ON 1 = 1 WHERE d.stages_reviewResult = 'Approve' ORDER BY d.stages_reviewedDateTime DESC LIMIT 1;
